privacy.note: Courtesy translation. The German version is authoritative.

p: The controller for data processing on this website is {legalName}, {address}. Email: {email}.
Please send questions about data protection to this email address.

We process personal data only as far as it is necessary to operate this website, to handle your enquiries and for security. We use no cookies, no analytics or tracking tools and no third-party content (for example fonts, maps or videos). All files are served from our own server.

This website is hosted by netcup GmbH in Germany. When you open the website, the server processes technically necessary connection data in log files: IP address, date and time, requested address, amount of data transferred, status code, browser and operating system details (user agent) and the page you came from (referrer).

The purpose is the secure and stable operation of the website. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure operation). The log files are deleted automatically after a short time. We have a data processing agreement with netcup GmbH under Art. 28 GDPR.

If you use the contact form or the quote form or write to us by email, we process your details (for example name, email address, message, project details) to answer your enquiry. Form data is sent to us by email and you receive an automatic acknowledgement. The emails are delivered and stored through the mail server of netcup GmbH (processor).

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR where your enquiry is aimed at a contract, otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in answering enquiries). Where you have consented to the processing (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), you can withdraw your consent at any time. Processing carried out until then remains lawful.

We delete your enquiry once it has been dealt with and no statutory retention duty applies. If a contract is concluded, we keep the business records for the periods required by commercial and tax law (usually six to ten years).

For the free analysis you enter your name, email address, your website address and search terms, and optionally industry, platform, budget and how you found us. First your browser solves a small computing task (proof of work) as protection against automated requests. No data is sent to third parties and no cookies are set.

We then store your details temporarily on our server and send you an email with a confirmation link. Only after you confirm do we pass the request on to ourselves and process it. The link is valid for 48 hours. If it is not confirmed, we delete the details automatically (daily clean-up).

To limit repeated and abusive requests, we store the requested domain for 90 days only as a check value (hash), not in plain text. We also count confirmed requests per week, without any personal data.

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (carrying out the analysis you asked for) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (protection against abuse). We send you the report by email. After that we treat the enquiry as described in the previous section. We do not use your email address from the analysis for advertising or newsletters unless you give separate consent.

To limit automated requests, every form submission stores a salted hash of your IP address together with the times of your latest requests. The value cannot easily be traced back to your IP address and is deleted after one day at the latest. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (protecting the website against abuse).

The only recipients of your data are ourselves and our hosting and email provider, netcup GmbH, as processor. We do not transfer data to countries outside the EU and the EEA and do not pass it on to third parties for advertising.

This website contains links to third-party websites, for example to reference projects. You only leave our website when you click such a link; no data is sent to those sites beforehand. The privacy notices of the respective operators apply to the processing there.

This website uses HTTPS (TLS encryption), shown by the lock symbol in the address bar. Your form data is therefore transmitted encrypted. Depending on the mail server, emails are not always transmitted encrypted. If that is a problem for you, please do not send confidential content by email.
No automated decision-making including profiling under Art. 22 GDPR takes place.

You have the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21). You can withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7(3)).
Where processing is based on a legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR), you can object to it at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation.
To exercise your rights, please write to {email}. We answer requests within one month.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The authority responsible for us is the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of Baden-Württemberg (Der Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit Baden-Württemberg), Lautenbergstraße 1, 70173 Stuttgart, www.baden-wuerttemberg.datenschutz.de. You can also contact the supervisory authority at your place of residence.
Date of this privacy policy: 19 October 2026. We update it when our services or the law change.
